title: The Affair at Blackwood Manor
motive_summary: Exposure of a deep, long-standing personal secret (romantic infidelity/professional deceit).
overview_text: The body of Nadia Cole was discovered in the dimly lit library, located in the 'Cafe Storage Room'. The victim lay slumped against a heavy oak desk, having sustained fatal injuries from what appears to be a blunt force trauma inflicted by an ornate letter opener, identified as the 'Brass till weight'. The body was tragically found by Ben Carter, who immediately called for assistance.
